perks.name: Enhancement 1
perks.description:
Once enhanced, this weapon will be granted a weapon level, a Memento socket, and access to additional weapon mods.

Enhancing will immediately replace this weapon's Masterwork with an enhanced intrinsic that is aligned with the current Masterwork stat.

perks.name: Enhancement 2
perks.description: Upgrading this weapon to Enhancement 2 will update the left-column trait perk(s).

perks.name: Enhancement 3
perks.description: Upgrading this weapon to Enhancement 3 will update the right-column trait perk(s).

name: Adored
flavorText: An Earth artifact, refashioned to suit the Spider's eclectic tastes.

intrinsic.name: Adaptive Frame
intrinsic.description: A well-rounded grip, reliable and sturdy.

originTraits.name: Accelerated Assault
originTraits.description: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads a small amount of ammo from reserves, or removes heat, and slightly increases damage.

originTraits.name: Problem Solver
originTraits.description:
Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

originTraits.name: Vanguard Determination
originTraits.description: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.description:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Headseeker

perks.name: Ancillary Ordinance
perks.description: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. Multiple missiles can be prepared.

perks.name: Bewildering Burst
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a disorienting blast.

perks.name: Lead From Light
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power causes your next final blow with this weapon to grant bonus Special ammo meter progress.

perks.name: Stopping Power
perks.description: This weapon's Kinetic ordinance can more easily stagger combatants, and grant increased target acquisition and damage against low-health targets.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.description: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Lucky Shot
perks.description: Reloading after a precision final blow causes precision hits to refill a round from reserves.

perks.name: Ancillary Ordinance

perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a longer-lasting disorienting blast.

perks.name: Lead From Light

perks.name: Stopping Power
perks.description: This weapon's Kinetic ordinance can more easily stagger combatants, and grant increased target acquisition and damage against low-health targets within an improved range.

perks.name: Lone Wolf

perks.name: Lucky Shot

perks.name: Adhesive Ordnance
perks.description: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, detonates shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.

perks.name: Kinetic Tremors
perks.description: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets.

perks.name: Mega Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

perks.name: All-Star
perks.description:

• [Void] increases stability.

Jolts targets when dealing damage. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

perks.name: Tunnel Vision
perks.description: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for a short duration.

perks.name: Heating Up
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon increase accuracy and stability while improving vertical recoil.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Full Auto Trigger System
perks.description: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.description: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.description: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.description: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Bandolier
perks.description: Grants slightly increased ammo generation and magazine size.

perks.description: Grants slightly increased ammo generation.
